behavior: Sessions plus button, desktop Create button and empty-workspace entrance open one Create dialog with Session and Draft tabs.
Start on Session for the existing shortcut workflow; preserve separate titles and directory selections when switching variants.
Draft uses optional title (Untitled fallback) and its own optional folder selector; clear selects the true top level.
Draft creation requires durable device persistence, but never requires a Machine, project, Provider or server connectivity.
Touch opens without claiming the keyboard, keeping both creation variants discoverable; tapping Title raises the keyboard. Desktop retains selected-title focus and Mod+Enter.
Explicit Create session/Create draft confirmation labels; disabled variant switching during creation and synchronous double-submit guard.
No creation snackbar: opening the persisted destination supplies the success feedback.

create_coverage: Actual production Create dialog under StrictMode on Desktop and touch branches
Empty Machine inventory disables Session but leaves Draft usable
Title and Draft folder survive variant switches
Session folder does not leak into Draft placement
Select a Draft folder, clear to root, create both placements
Offline creation stores locally before navigating
Double click creates exactly one Draft
